reasons.openObjects: The message schemas close with additionalProperties: false and leave out messaging_product and context, which every sendMessage example sends.
reasons.optional.recipient_type: BaseMessageProperties and MarketingMessageRequestPayload require it; Send Test Message, Send Contact Message and seven more examples leave it out (the API defaults to individual).
reasons.optional.policy: LanguageObject requires it; every template example sends only the code (the API defaults to deterministic).
reasons.oneOfAsAnyOf: The branches of the interactive action overlap (a reply button fits two), so oneOf refuses Send Reply Button.
reasons.addBranches.ActionObject: ActionObject has no shape for the payment actions: Send Order Details Message (review_and_pay) and Send Order Status Message (review_order) send name and parameters.
reasons.requiredQuery.deleteTemplateByName: Deleting a template needs its name (with hsm_id for one language); the spec lists name as optional.
reasons.defaults.sendMessage: The API sends text when type is left out; Send Text Message with Preview URL leaves it out.
reasons.optional.CallRequestPayload: The schema requires to on every call action; Meta's guide (User-initiated calls) sends pre_accept, accept and reject with call_id and no to, and to is the callee only on connect.
reasons.optional.OfficialBusinessAccountUpdateRe: The submit, withdraw and resubmit examples send neither business_website_url nor primary_country_of_operation.
reasons.looseProperties: Send Location Message sends latitude and longitude as numbers where the schema asks for strings; the compliance examples send phone numbers the pattern refuses; template button index is a number in the examples and its pattern is not a valid range.
reasons.extendEnums.button: The interactive type enum misses order_details and order_status, the types of Send Order Details Message and Send Order Status Message.
reasons.extendEnums.quick_reply: The button sub_type enum misses CATALOG and flow, used by Send Catalog Template Message and Send Flow Template Message, and copy_code, the coupon of a copy-code button (Meta's guide: Copy code buttons).
reasons.extendEnums.header,body,button: The template component type enum misses carousel (the cards of a media card carousel template, Meta's guide: Media card carousel templates) and limited_time_offer (Limited-time offer templates).
reasons.brokenExamples.sendMessage: Send Reply to List Message has no type and an interactive body (type defaults to text); Send Multi-Product Message keeps the placeholder <HEADER_TYPE>. Neither is a call the API accepts as written.
